mechanism: Triamcinolone (corticosteroid) can cause sodium and fluid retention and increase blood pressure, potentially counteracting the antihypertensive effects of irbesartan (ARB), while irbesartan may increase hyperkalemia risk when combined with corticosteroid-induced hypokalemia complications.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely during concurrent use; may require dose adjustment of irbesartan; monitor serum electrolytes (potassium) periodically; educate patient on sodium restriction.
